prompt:
Bold clean ink linework, flat vibrant cell-shaded colors, rounded expressive character designs, distinctive 1980s Akira Toriyama manga aesthetic. Create ONE finished landscape 1536x1024 comic panel, NOT a character sheet. Alien game world under THREE blazing suns, non-graphic catastrophe and ash. 
SCENE: 풀 페이지. 하늘 전체를 세 개의 태양이 가득 채운다. 구도: 위에서부터 시계 방향으로 큰 붉은 태양, 작은 흰 태양, 세 번째 붉은 태양. 지면은 화면 하단 1/5에만. 주희가 평원 한가운데 서서 양팔을 벌린 채 세 태양을 맞이하고 있다 — 옷이 타들어가기 시작. 주희의 몸에서 연기가 오른다. NPC 문명인들이 비명과 함께 녹아내린다 — 과장된 포즈로. 왕먀오는 화면 오른쪽 아래 구석에서 손으로 눈을 가리고 있다. 안경 렌즈가 세 태양의 빛에 백색으로 타오른다 — 렌즈가 거울처럼 변했다. 빛이 사방에서 쏟아진다. 그림자가 완전히 사라진 세계.
Visible named cast: 왕먀오, 주희. Character sheets are identity references ONLY; never copy their backgrounds. Wang Miao always wears pale blue-grey shirt and dark trousers. All lettering and exact digits will be added later: NO readable text, numbers, symbols, balloons, captions or watermark in generated artwork. Clean coherent anatomy, strong ink composition, no extra characters or alien creatures. Non-graphic disaster where described.

repairs.prompt: Bold clean ink linework, flat vibrant cell-shaded colors, rounded expressive character designs, dramatic but playful composition, distinctive 1980s Akira Toriyama manga aesthetic. Simple but expressive backgrounds with bold black shadows. Clean panel borders, dynamic perspective. Edit the first supplied comic panel. Preserve its composition, camera, identity, lighting and story except the precise correction requested here. Replace the central long-haired woman with the SAME MALE KING from the second reference, wearing his red robe and black armor with black topknot and beard. His arms are spread in quiet acceptance. Heat and drifting ash around the robe, intact clothed body with no graphic injury. Preserve the scientist shielding his spectacles at lower right and the three suns. Return one finished panel, no comparison sheet.
